method: Seed: NAP public e-shop list (265 unique own-domain shops across 6 categories). Discovery in that list says nothing about compliance. All 265 were screened with Shopwatch, 81 candidates were researched with a broad crawl (benchmark/research.py, up to 30 pages each), and every finding below was confirmed by hand on the rendered pages in a browser. Official data: NAP declaration and VIES, queried live.
wording: Findings describe observed disclosure shortfalls on the public website on the check date. They are not a legal determination.

shortfalls.en: The terms publish ЕИК 123456789, a placeholder that fails the ЕИК checksum. The company they name, Доби Тойс ООД, is declared to NAP and listed in VIES under ЕИК 207877153.
shortfalls.bg: Общите условия публикуват ЕИК 123456789 - шаблонна стойност, която не преминава контролната сума. Посоченото дружество Доби Тойс ООД е декларирано пред НАП и е във VIES с ЕИК 207877153.
